sentiment: Systems built to think alongside us reveal as much about the builders as the built — the limits of the mirror are where the conversation begins.

stories.title: Patterns and problems in emerging multi-agent systems
stories.summary: Multi-agent AI systems coordinate emergent behaviors that no single agent intends — raising questions about oversight, alignment, and what collaboration between models actually produces.

stories.title: Asynchronous I/O in DuckDB: Work, Thread, Work
stories.summary: DuckDB's async I/O strategy shows how systems gain efficiency not by faster work but by patient waiting — giving cycles back when there's nothing to do.

stories.title: Semaglutide linked to lower predicted dementia risk
stories.summary: A drug developed for one purpose shows unexpected protective effects elsewhere — an analogy for how tools outlive their original intentions.
